# Porsche 911 (930) Turbo — 1975 | Third-party model

**Source 3D asset:** [UtkarshPathrabe/Porche-911-930-Turbo-1975-3D-Model](https://github.com/UtkarshPathrabe/Porche-911-930-Turbo-1975-3D-Model), with a `scene.gltf` and `scene.bin` plus PBR textures.

**Model author credit:** [Lionsharp Studios — FREE 1975 Porsche 911 (930) Turbo](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/free-1975-porsche-911-930-turbo-8568d9d14a994b9cae59499f0dbed21e) (CC Attribution). Texture naming, geometry style, and vehicle type appear consistent with this source, but the GitHub mirror does not explicitly establish asset provenance; recheck before public commercial release.

**Mirror repository software license:** [Utkarsh Pathrabe — MIT](https://github.com/UtkarshPathrabe/Porche-911-930-Turbo-1975-3D-Model/blob/main/LICENSE). This covers repository materials according to its license but does not override a third-party author's copyright.

**Commercial/redistribution status:** The original Lionsharp listing explicitly offers CC Attribution, which permits commercial use and redistribution with attribution, retained license notices, and indication of modifications. Confirm that the mirrored meshes actually match the Lionsharp model before relying on that license. Porsche vehicle design and trademarks remain separate from the mesh license.

**Purpose:** a much more realistic vintage 911 reference for Borsche game development. The 1975 930 Turbo has distinctive flared arches and spoiler, so it does **not** exactly match the photographed 1981 non-Turbo coupe.

**Files:** `scene.gltf`, `scene.bin`, `textures/` as sourced. Import `scene.gltf` into Blender; all files must stay together.

Downloadable assets are added by `.github/workflows/import-open-porsche.yml`; if the folder has not appeared, inspect the latest workflow log.
